name: EXPLORE-Bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on egocentric scene prediction with long-horizon reasoning. Given an initial scene and a sequence of actions, models predict the final scene, with fine-grained annotations supporting quantitative assessment of object categories, attributes, and relations.
reputation: A relatively new benchmark with limited but growing use in multimodal and embodied reasoning research.
notes: Benchmark curated from real first-person videos; highlights challenges in long-horizon egocentric reasoning.
